name: sigil-mcp-server
description: SIGIL — Sovereign Identity-Gated Interaction Layer. Security middleware for AI agent tool calls: secret scanning, trust-level policy enforcement, Ed25519-signed audit envelopes.

tools.name: scan
tools.description: Scan arbitrary text for security issues: leaked secrets (AWS keys, OpenAI tokens, GitHub PATs, RSA private keys), PII patterns, and prompt injection attempts. Returns hit, pattern, severity, and blocked status.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check. Returns server version, SIGIL DID method, license, and beta1=0 invariant.
